cohort: A 26-year-old primigravida presented with palpitations and dizziness at 32 weeks gestation, diagnosed with ILFVT and underlying congenital valvular abnormalities.
finding: This case highlights that ILFVT in pregnancy complicated by valvular abnormalities can be successfully managed with transcutaneous pacing and verapamil for acute symptoms, followed by definitive postpartum radiofrequency ablation for excellent long-term outcomes.
